description:
Find the company's saved clients.

Look a recipient up here before typing one into issue_invoice:
when it is already saved, pass its id as client_id and the name,
document and address come from the registry. Most recently used
first unless sort_by says otherwise. Read-only.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

inactive.description: List the deactivated clients instead of the active ones.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page: offset + limit.

search.description: Part of the name, or the CPF/CNPJ with or without punctuation.

source.description: Only those saved from this source.

name: list_clients

ClientRecord.description: One client the company keeps between issuances.

id.description: Pass it as client_id to issue_invoice or save_client.

source.description: manual, issued (imported from issued invoices) or issuance (saved by an issuance).

tax_id.description: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 characters, unpunctuated). A CNPJ may carry letters in its first 12 positions since July 2026, so never treat it as a number.

outputSchema.description: A page of the company's clients.

total.description: How many match, not how many are here.
